errors.text: The proposed bulk addition of Ti, Al, Cr, and Si does not reconstruct the supported silicide-coating intervention; Ti is already an equiatomic constituent of HfNbTaTiZr.
No concentrations, addition route, resulting composition, or processing schedule are specified, so the intervention cannot be reproduced or assessed for retention of mechanical properties.
The cited evidence concerns high-temperature strength of other refractory alloys and does not support oxidation protection by Ti-Al-Cr-Si additions in equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr.
The mechanism is only a generic protective-scale assertion and omits the supported self-healing silicide-scale mechanism involving oxide filling by Zr/Hf oxides.
The experiment lacks a quantitative falsification threshold and does not distinguish oxidation resistance from strength changes caused by extensive bulk alloy modification.
